race.comment: XTRA BLACK (10) sets the standard after a sound debut fourth at Echuca over 1000m, beaten just over half a length despite beginning awkwardly, being bumped shortly after the start and covering ground. Should improve from that and gets every chance from the gate. GOZAIMASU (8) is the obvious danger among the debutants, having won trials at Moe, Balnarring and Sandown-Hillside within a five-trial grounding. Should be ready to go. BRUCEISMYNAME (7) also debuts after three trials and is worth respect for the Oliver yard. He draws well, watch betting. MO MO'S CHOISE (2) could be an improver this time around.
